messages:
lia: Quick report: during a local creds rotation I hit inconsistent auth behavior in the Go SDK.
ben: what happened?
lia: We rotate creds via local-agent which writes ~/.redwood/creds.json then exports REDWOOD_API_KEY. New outgoing calls pick the new key but background retries for in-flight requests keep using the old key, causing repeated 401s.
ryan: sounds like getToken() was sampled once at request start and reused for retries. that's a parity gap with other SDKs.
claire: We should only re-fetch on auth failure (401/403) to avoid hammering KMS-backed providers.
lia: Agreed. Also noticed this only showed up when rotation does an atomic rename on mac/linux. Watching inode mtime alone misses the change.
ben: good call. implement detection as mtime + quick sha1 checksum. inexpensive and reliable.
ryan: API surface: add Client.RefreshCreds(ctx) and make retry-on-auth call CredProvider.Refresh() before retrying. opt-in flag credHotReload=true by default, and REDWOOD_CRED_HOTRELOAD=false to disable.
claire: add invariant: REDWOOD_PROJECT_ID and REDWOOD_ORG_ID are init-only. If they change at runtime, log error and require process restart. routing decisions are expensive and unsafe to mutably change.
lia: can we also add a small opt-out for hot-reload in hosted environments? some infra tests want deterministic behavior.
ben: that's REDWOOD_CRED_HOTRELOAD=false cover. also recommend an environment REDWOOD_CRED_POLL_INTERVAL with sane defaults (2s for env, 5s + jitter for file).
ryan: logging: emit info when token source switches (env -> file -> kms) and when a retry triggers credential refresh. very helpful for debugging in CI/dev.
claire: example snippet to detect file change: ```go
// pseudocode
func fileChanged(path string, lastMtime int64, lastHash string) (bool, int64, string) {
  stat := os.Stat(path)
  curM := stat.ModTime().Unix()
  if curM != lastMtime { h := sha1OfFile(path); return h != lastHash, curM, h }
  return false, lastMtime, lastHash
}
```
lia: nice. i'll validate with local-agent and add examples/rotate-demo.sh in the sample apps.
ben: create integration test: rotate creds mid-request, assert no infinite 401 loops and client eventually uses new token after retry.
deploy-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go/pull/321 - feat: cred hot-reload + retry refresh; tests green :white_check_mark:
ryan: filing cross-SDK parity issue and tagging eng-sdk to sync py/js/go. GH issue #1602 created.
claire: small UX: add a short info log when a manual Client.RefreshCreds() succeeds so operators know rotation finished.
lia: thanks all. will test the staging build and report results here. tagging @eng-sdk for review. :pray:
